changes: Added a retained monotonic capture revocation epoch incremented under the backend process lock by release_held_input; capture snapshots and checks it during lock wait, subprocess completion, image polling, final identity, and the lock-protected prepublication os.replace.

Created each GNOME output in a fresh mode-0700 attempt directory on the destination filesystem; atomically renamed the directory to a retired name before removal so delayed writers cannot recreate the original pathname.

Kept the exact gnome-screenshot -f argv and admission path while validating PNG signatures, terminal format/dimension failures, Pillow verification, and full decode; accepted desktop dimensions at least as large as the verified client for the existing crop contract.

Expanded tests with delayed revocation/rearm, lock-wait revocation, attempt privacy and retirement, larger desktop acceptance, immediate wrong-format/undersized refusal, and one-second real-writer refusal budgets.
label: gnome-capture-r2
limitations: No real GUI capture or native calibration was run; production boundary behavior is exercised with owned admission-wrapped writers.
